evidence.name: Screen field: Name the new variable
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Name the new variable" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Name the new variable
sections.description: A readable name for the variable you're creating, like User Goal, that must be unique across the funnel. It becomes the reference you use elsewhere — usually a lowercased, underscored form such as @user_goal in dynamic text and conditions. Pick a clear name that describes the answer (User Goal, Experience Level) rather than the screen, since later references depend on it and you won't want to rename it.
